title: Report missing values first
when: Any analysis that aggregates, filters, or models columns
instruction: Before computing results, report the count and share of missing values for every column used, and state how they are handled (dropped or imputed).

title: Use medians for skewed money columns
when: Summarising revenue, price, income, or other monetary columns
instruction: Report the median alongside the mean and flag the column as skewed when mean exceeds median by more than 20%.

title: Label charts fully
when: The request asks for a chart or plot
instruction: Every chart has a title, axis labels with units, and a source note naming the data file.

title: Parse dates explicitly
when: A date or datetime column is used
instruction: Parse date columns with an explicit format and state the time range covered by the data.

title: Show group sizes
when: Results are grouped or compared across categories
instruction: Include the number of rows in each group next to every grouped statistic and flag groups with fewer than 10 rows.

title: Do not claim causation
instruction: Describe relationships as associations; never state or imply that one variable causes another.
